name: Youth Conservation Corps (Rocky Mountain Youth Corps)
what_you_do: Join a crew of 8 to 10 peers and two crew leaders for two or four weeks of trail building, restoration and work on invasive species and wildlife habitat. You camp together at night.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 6 to 12 in Northwest Colorado. Groups: Adventurers (6th and 7th), Trailblazers (8th and 9th), Outdoor Leaders (10th to 12th).
pay_detail: Outdoor Leaders get a $1,455.36 stipend for 4 weeks. Trailblazers is called a volunteer program. The Adventurers pages give no pay or cost.
duration: Two or four weeks, between June 6 and Aug 5, 2027
deadline_text: 2027 dates are posted. Outdoor Leaders applications open Feb 1, 2027. Adventurers and Trailblazers registration opens Mar 1, 2027.
how_to_apply: Outdoor Leaders fill out the form on the application page. Adventurers and Trailblazers sign up on their group pages. Questions: Kimberly Tholis (Director) or Shawn O'Kane (Manager). The page has a Reach Out link.
notes: More than 200 teens join each year. Based in Steamboat Springs. Parents have a policy page. The Colorado Youth Corps Association lists the youth program as ages 14 to 18. Trailblazers from outside Routt or Moffat counties must contact the team first.
